title: Secure Signal Admin API
description: REST API for the Secure Signal Admin Next.js app. All authenticated routes use Supabase session cookies (sb-access-token / sb-refresh-token). Role checks: admin > authority > user.

rbac.admin: Full access; admin-only routes check profile.role === 'admin'.
rbac.authority: May patch incident status, send device pings.
rbac.user: May manage own emergency contacts, read own incidents.

routes.description: OAuth callback. Exchanges `code` for a Supabase session and redirects to `next` (defaults to /). On failure redirects to /login?error=oauth.

routes.auth: POST: admin or authority. PATCH: unauthed (device acknowledgement).
routes.description: Authority/admin pings a device; device acks receipt. Triggers FCM push via sendPing() when notifications row exists.

responses.201: POST -> { data: { id, device_id, status:"sent", created_at } }

sideEffects: Lookup latest notifications.device_firebase_id, send FCM (best-effort, errors logged not thrown).
Insert log row action=ping.sent, entity=device, entity_id=device_id, meta.ping_id.

routes.description: Public contact form submit; admin reads submissions.

responses.200: GET -> { data: Contact[] (up to 100, newest first) }

routes.auth: POST: unauthed (device posts). GET: unauthed (RLS restricts reads).
routes.description: Devices post new incidents with lat/lng; consumers list by date.

query.date: YYYY-MM-DD (optional) — filter occurred_at within UTC day

routes.notes: location stored as PostGIS WKT: `SRID=4326;POINT(lng lat)`.

routes.description: Staff-only listing powering the admin/authority incidents dashboard. Joins profile + device. Realtime-capable: clients subscribe to postgres_changes on public.incidents and merge deltas into this slice.

query.date: YYYY-MM-DD (optional) — UTC calendar day, filters created_at
query.from: ISO timestamp (optional) — inclusive lower bound when date not set
query.to: ISO timestamp (optional) — inclusive upper bound when date not set

routes.description: Update incident.status and mark read=true. Writes audit log row.
sideEffects: Insert log row action=incident.status, entity=incident, entity_id=id, meta.status.

routes.auth: POST: unauthed (device posts breadcrumb; RLS restricts reads). GET: admin or authority only.
routes.description: Device-side location breadcrumb trail for an active incident (table: incident_logs). POST is called periodically by the reporting device while an emergency is in progress; GET returns the most recent 100 points for staff. The admin/authority monitor view also subscribes to INSERTs on incident_logs via Supabase Realtime for live tracking.

postRequest.device_uuid: string (optional) — used to resolve device_id if the incident has none

sideEffects: Inserts a row into incident_logs (incident_id, user_id, device_id, lat, lng).
Triggers a Supabase Realtime postgres_changes INSERT event on incident_logs consumed by the monitor view.

routes.description: List or create the calling user's emergency contacts.

routes.auth: Any logged-in user; scoped to own rows via .eq("user_id", user.id).

responses.200: PATCH -> { data: row } ; DELETE -> { ok: true }

routes.description: Admin: list/insert any user's emergency contacts.
Admin: update or delete any emergency contact by id.

responses.200: PATCH -> { data: row } ; DELETE -> { ok: true }

routes.description: Handles checkout.session.completed, customer.subscription.{created,updated,deleted}. Upserts subscriptions table on conflict subscription_id; logs all events.
handledEvents: checkout.session.completed — retrieve subscription via session.subscription, upsert
routes.metadata: subscription.metadata.supabase_user_id MUST be set at checkout; otherwise row skipped.
sideEffects: Insert log row action=stripe.<event_type>, entity=stripe, entity_id=event.id
